explanation: The theorem concerns the library's own definitions `Ideal.Quotient.gradedComponent`, `gradedDecomposePre` and `gradedDecompose` (a decomposition of `A ⧸ I` into the images of the homogeneous components under the quotient map). Grepping Mathlib for `gradedDecompose`, `gradedComponent`, `LeftInverse`/`coeAddMonoidHom` combinations, and for any grading on `Ideal.Quotient` / `GradedRing` structure on quotients by homogeneous ideals found nothing: Mathlib has no graded-ring structure on quotients, only the generic `DirectSum.Decomposition` class (`Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Decomposition.lean`), whose `left_inv` field is just a structure projection carrying no mathematical content about this construction. So there is no Mathlib declaration stating this result.
